cohort: 177 late preterm infants whose mothers received antenatal corticosteroids between 24 and 34 weeks gestation matched by gestational age and birth weight with 177 infants who did not
finding: Antenatal corticosteroids did not decrease the risk of respiratory morbidity in late preterm infants.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight 2270 +/- 405 g in the antenatal corticosteroid group and 2265 +/- 401 g in the no antenatal corticosteroid group
